stories.title: Delhi considers deposit return scheme for tobacco packaging
stories.summary: The Delhi government is considering a deposit return scheme to encourage recycling, with PET bottles and tobacco packaging like gutkha and khaini likely to be included. Environment Minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa said the proposal aims to prevent recyclable waste from harming the environment. The litter has been noticed.

stories.title: Delhi proposes refunds for returned tobacco packets
stories.summary: Delhi is considering a deposit return scheme where consumers pay an additional amount for tobacco products and receive a refund upon returning empty packaging. The initiative aims to reduce litter and is expected to cover plastic bottles as well. The packaging is currently being tracked.

stories.title: Pay Extra For Gutkha, Get Money Back: Delhi Plans Deposit Scheme For Plastic Bottles, Tobacco Packets - NDTV Profit
FSSAI begins nationwide testing of packaged drinking water
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India is collecting samples of packaged drinking water for nationwide lab testing, with results expected in two months. CEO Rajit Punhani also announced plans to inspect food grade packaging materials. The regulator is currently looking for things.

stories.title: FSSAI launches nationwide water testing drive
stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has begun collecting samples of packaged drinking water from across the country to ensure safety. CEO Rajit Punhani said the process will take at least one to two months to complete. The country is large.

stories.title: Perak weighs enforcement on polystyrene containers
stories.summary: Following a statewide ban on single-use plastic bags, the Perak government is considering municipal enforcement to crack down on polystyrene food containers. State official Teh Kok Lim noted that while prohibitions have existed for years, local councils have faced persistent operational hurdles in policing compliance.

stories.title: Perak threatens licence revocation for plastic bag offenders
stories.summary: Perak has enforced a ban on single-use plastic carrier bags, with repeat offenders risking the revocation of their business licences. Enforcement is being carried out in stages across 15 local authorities, starting with warning notices. The state is currently finalising guidelines for uniform implementation.

stories.title: Guwahati municipal body targets banned plastics
stories.summary: The Guwahati Municipal Corporation conducted an enforcement drive at Fancy Bazar to evict unauthorized vendors and warn shopkeepers against using banned plastic items. Mayor Mrigen Sarania led the operation as part of a citywide cleanliness campaign. The campaign is currently ongoing.

stories.title: Guwahati officials inspect market for banned plastics
stories.summary: Guwahati Mayor Mrigen Sarania led an enforcement drive at Fancy Bazar to remove unauthorized vendors and curb the use of banned single-use plastics. Shopkeepers were instructed to discontinue prohibited items and shift to eco-friendly alternatives. The market is being asked to change.

stories.title: Styrenix Performance Materials pauses expansion after capacity boost
stories.summary: Styrenix Performance Materials has expanded its polystyrene production capacity to 100 KT per annum by resolving internal constraints. Management has elected to defer further capital outlay until market conditions improve. The capacity is now at the desired level.

stories.title: US aluminium trihydrate prices rise 0.89% in October as freight costs jump on Santos-Houston route - AL Circle
Polypropylene packaging films market outlook strengthens
stories.summary: The polypropylene packaging films market is experiencing growth driven by demand in food, pharmaceutical, and personal care industries. The Business Research Company reports that the sector is set for sustained expansion as packaging needs evolve. The market is currently growing.

stories.title: Bioplastics market competition shifts as supply expands
stories.summary: The bioplastics for packaging market is evolving through resin capacity expansion and application-specific polymer development. Future Market Insights reports that material producers and packaging manufacturers are competing to serve brand owners seeking alternative materials. The market is currently being assessed.

stories.title: PVDC coatings market grows on food shelf-life demand
stories.summary: The global market for PVDC coatings is entering a phase of steady expansion as brand owners prioritize packaging that protects sensitive products. IndexBox reports that the coatings are valued for their barrier against oxygen and moisture. The shelf life has been extended.

stories.title: PGP Glass being sold in $1.7B private equity deal - Packaging Dive
Loop Industries appoints interim CEO and raises funds
stories.summary: Loop Industries has appointed Adel Essaddam as interim CEO and raised approximately $5.9 million. The company reported progress on its India joint venture, which includes a planned plant to produce recycled polyester from textile waste. The venture is currently being financed.

stories.title: All Reflex Cushioning Plants Now Run on Recycled Resin - PlasticsToday
Vortex World Trade expands recycling network across India
stories.summary: Vortex World Trade is expanding its warehouse network across Gujarat and Rajasthan to connect regional scrap suppliers with industrial buyers. The company focuses on organized sourcing and distribution to improve the supply of recyclable materials to manufacturers and recycling processors. The network is currently growing.

stories.title: Korea Railroad Research Institute commercializes plastic sleepers
stories.summary: The Korea Railroad Research Institute has installed circular composite sleepers made from recycled waste plastic on Busan Metro Line 2. The material is designed to replace timber sleepers and can be crushed and reprocessed after use. The infrastructure now includes glass fiber reinforcement.

stories.title: Kenya eyes new Japanese technology to build roads using recycled plastic waste - The Eastleigh Voice
Trichy corporation sends 4,474 tonnes of plastic to cement kilns
stories.summary: The Trichy corporation has completed 500 trips to transport non-recyclable plastic waste to a private cement factory in Ariyalur. Over two years, 4,474 tonnes of waste were used as fuel for kilns instead of being sent to city landfills. The city generates 450 tonnes of waste daily.

stories.title: Researchers warn of physical and chemical hazards from plastic pellets
stories.summary: A study by researchers from ten countries indicates that plastic resin pellets, or nurdles, pose widespread threats to marine ecosystems. These two to five millimeter particles are used as feedstock for manufacturing. While documented in oceans since the 1970s, international regulatory standards remain absent.

stories.title: RES plastics plant uses optical sorting to process 40,000 tonnes
stories.summary: RES began operating a plastics sorting plant in January 2024 capable of processing 40,000 tonnes of waste annually. The facility uses ten optical sorters from Pellenc ST to separate plastics by polymer type. The plant handles municipal, commercial, and industrial waste streams.

stories.title: Mexico packaging industry awaits rules for circular economy law
stories.summary: Mexico has incorporated extended producer responsibility into its General Law of Circular Economy, requiring brands to finance and organize packaging recovery. Although the law was published nearly a year ago, the specific rules required to trigger these obligations have not yet been established.

stories.title: UK drinks industry warns of costs despite glass fee cuts
stories.summary: Britain's hospitality and drinks industries report that packaging reform still threatens higher costs, citing unclear reporting duties and potential double charging. The concerns persist despite the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs cutting planned extended producer responsibility charges for glass packaging earlier in November.

stories.title: Oregon glass packaging EPR fee drops to zero for 2027
stories.summary: Oregon's extended producer responsibility fee for glass packaging will reach zero in 2027. The base fee was reduced by 60 percent, and reserve credits from the Circular Action Alliance covered the remaining costs. The Glass Packaging Institute led the multiyear effort to revise collection rules.

stories.title: Dairy industry faces new packaging compliance costs
stories.summary: Extended producer responsibility laws are shifting recycling management costs to consumer goods producers. Dairy manufacturers report that these policies may affect packaging choices critical to food safety and shelf life. The industry is currently evaluating the impact of these new state-level compliance requirements.

stories.title: EU & US EPR: Still Riddled With Complexities - Packaging Digest
Extended producer responsibility shifts waste accountability to companies
stories.summary: Extended producer responsibility laws are moving waste management accountability from governments to private companies. The shift requires firms to implement better data collection, oversight, and connected systems to manage their expanding compliance obligations under the new regulatory framework.

stories.title: Podcast explores shift from voluntary goals to mandatory packaging regulation
stories.summary: The Through the Line podcast examines the transition of sustainable packaging from a voluntary corporate goal to a regulatory requirement. The discussion focuses on how mandatory extended producer responsibility laws are forcing brands to change their approach to packaging design and recovery.

stories.title: Survey finds companies unclear on packaging labelling rules
stories.summary: A survey of 32 brands and suppliers found that managing country-specific differences is the primary concern for companies under packaging and waste regulation. Respondents cited updating labels and understanding legal requirements as significant challenges when trading across multiple European markets.

stories.title: Paper recycling market analysis identifies key industry participants
stories.summary: Future Market Insights has released a competitive analysis of the paper recycling market, identifying firms like International Paper and Smurfit Westrock as key players. The report covers regional supply chain developments and the commercial implications of changes in recovered-paper sourcing and packaging operations.

stories.title: Paper core board market growth projected to 2035
stories.summary: The global paper core board market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement and a diversified supply architecture. The sector supplies rigid paperboard for winding processes in textile and film manufacturing. Demand remains supported by converting industries requiring specialized carrier substrates.

stories.title: Recyclable High-Barrier Packaging: Nfinite and Amcor Develop Protective Paper Alternatives - Trend Hunter
Nfinite Paper wins sustainability award
stories.summary: Nfinite Nanotechnology and Amcor won a Packaging Europe Sustainability Award for their high-barrier paper packaging. The material was recognized in the Start-Up New Materials category at the Sustainable Packaging Summit in Utrecht. The company says it is shaping the future of flexible packaging.

stories.title: Nfinite Paper Wins Packaging Europe's award for Packaging Sustainability at 2026 Sustainable Packaging Summit - Quantisn
Paper packaging material wins sustainability award
stories.summary: Nfinite Nanotechnology and Amcor won a 2026 Packaging Europe Sustainability Award for Nfinite Paper, a material developed for flexible packaging. The product consists of 85% to 90% fiber. The award was presented in the Start-Up New Materials category at the Sustainable Packaging Summit.

stories.title: Tetra Pak launches paper carton for spoonable foods
stories.summary: Tetra Pak has introduced the Tetra Reva, a paper-based carton designed for spoonable foods like yoghurt and puddings. The container features a full-top opening and a pull-ring lid intended for one-movement access. The company describes the design as a world first for the category.

stories.title: Paper packaging market projected to reach $662.3 billion by 2036
stories.summary: The global paper packaging market is estimated at $336.6 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach $662.3 billion by 2036. Growth is attributed to plastic substitution and e-commerce demand. India is expected to lead global growth with an 8.5% annual rate.

stories.title: Teagasc researches straw for sustainable packaging
stories.summary: Researchers at Teagasc are investigating the use of cereal straw as a feedstock for sustainable packaging. The byproduct of wheat and oat crops has traditionally been used for bedding or mulch. The project is funded by the Department of Agriculture and Food Development Authority.

stories.title: Haitian adds capacity for large-tonnage molding machines in China - Plastics News
Brückner Group expands India production facility
stories.summary: Brückner Group has expanded its Navi Mumbai workshop from 500 to 2,500 square meters. The company says the move is intended to align its offerings with local market requirements. More than 150 industry representatives attended a recent customer event in New Delhi.

stories.title: Orkka launches high-speed void fill system
stories.summary: Orkka has released the LockedPaper V3 system, which converts fanfold kraft paper into cushioning at speeds up to 80 meters per minute. The dispenser is designed for e-commerce and manufacturing environments. It features a foot pedal for continuous feed or preset size selection.

stories.title: Echaar makes Loupe debut in 2026 - Packaging South Asia
Shibaura Machine debuts vertical molding line
stories.summary: Shibaura Machine is showcasing its LWB vertical injection molding machines at the IPF 2026 event in Tokyo. The company is also presenting new AI-powered manufacturing tools alongside the hardware. The debut marks the product line's introduction to the Japanese market.

stories.title: Surat’s Madhavi Offset installs a fleet of machines from SASG - Packaging South Asia
Textile machinery market shifts toward automation
stories.summary: The global fabric slitting machines market is entering 2026 with a focus on disciplined procurement and diversified supply chains. These machines convert wide fabric rolls for use in apparel, home furnishings, and flexible packaging. Growth is tied to capital expenditure cycles in textile mills.

stories.title: Siemens launches AI engineering agent in India
stories.summary: Siemens has introduced the Eigen Engineering Agent in India to automate tasks like PLC coding and device configuration. The company says the tool uses multi-step reasoning and self-correction. It has been piloted with more than 16 customers in the region.

stories.title: Pet deodorizing spray refill market sees growth
stories.summary: The global pet deodorizing spray refill market is characterized by high-frequency replenishment and brand loyalty. As pet humanization increases, the refill format is being marketed as a recurring revenue stream for brands and a lower cost-per-use option for multi-pet households.

stories.title: Cleansing balm kit market grows with ritual-driven demand
stories.summary: The global cleansing balm kit market is expanding as consumers shift toward premium, multi-step skincare routines. Unlike single-SKU products, these kits bundle balms with cloths or tools. The market is forecast to grow through 2035 as ritual-driven formats become mainstream.

stories.title: Sample bags market driven by industrial demand
stories.summary: The global sample bags market serves sectors ranging from mining to pharmaceuticals, providing containers for contamination-free storage and transport. The market enters 2026 with a focus on disciplined procurement and broader demand fundamentals. E-commerce and eco-friendly materials are cited as growth factors.

stories.title: Frozen food packaging faces new scrutiny
stories.summary: Following cyberattacks on European supermarket freezers, experts suggest stronger seals and puncture-resistant packaging to maintain integrity during temperature fluctuations. Amcor, Coveris, ExxonMobil, Hydropac, and Rapids Paper + Packaging are promoting various formats. The industry is now focused on recyclability and food-safe recycled content as the next challenge.

stories.title: Stackable storage market shifts to lifestyle branding
stories.summary: IndexBox reports that the global stackable kitchen storage market is bifurcating. High-volume commodity segments face margin pressure, while premium products command price premiums by positioning organization as a wellness routine. Households are increasingly treating pantry storage as a lifestyle choice rather than a simple utility.

stories.title: Makeup remover wipes market targets premium segments
stories.summary: The global makeup remover wipes market is entering a phase of structural bifurcation. A price-sensitive core coexists with a premium segment that commands higher margins through skincare claims. Consumer demand is shifting from basic removal to hydration, anti-aging, and ingredient purity. The wipes now do more than wipe.

stories.title: The Rise of Cross-Border E-Commerce: How Indian SMEs Can Reach Customers in the UK and Australia - Content Media Solutio
Corrugated plastic box market leans into reusability
stories.summary: The global corrugated plastic box market is moving toward structural differentiation. Growth is increasingly concentrated in reusable, application-specific designs rather than commodity utility boxes. As e-commerce networks expand, retailers are prioritizing durable, brand-aligned secondary packaging over standard options. The box is becoming a strategic asset.

stories.title: ProAmpac closing two packaging plants, cutting 134 jobs - Plastics News
Mars invests £161 million in Melton Mowbray site
stories.summary: Mars is investing £161 million to produce mono-PP pouches, a single-material format designed to be recyclable. The project includes smart optical sorting technology expected to cut production waste by more than 50 percent. The company describes the upgrades as a vote of confidence in the local workforce.

stories.title: Peak Packaging expands with £10 million investment
stories.summary: Peak Packaging is investing £10 million in a new facility in the East Midlands. The company, which supplies Bag-in-Box products, intends to use the site to support long-term growth across the UK and Europe. The investment includes new machinery and infrastructure to serve existing customers.

stories.title: Brookfield acquires PGP Glass for $1.7 billion
stories.summary: Brookfield Asset Management has agreed to acquire PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.7 billion. The manufacturer produces speciality glass packaging for cosmetics, fragrance, and food industries across 70 countries. Brookfield plans to support the company's growth through investments in manufacturing capacity and expansion.

stories.title: Kshitij Polyline announces UAE recycling plant
stories.summary: Kshitij Polyline Limited has announced a 65 crore rupee investment for a recycling plant in the UAE. The facility will process plastic and e-waste into recycled sheets for stationery. The company has not yet disclosed the plant's capacity, precise location, or the date it will begin operations.

stories.title: Alterra buys Pryme's development arm to anchor European recycling push - Dealroom
Qnity to acquire Meridian electronics business
stories.summary: Qnity Electronics has agreed to acquire the electronics business of Meridian Adhesives Group for $840 million. The move aims to strengthen Qnity's position in semiconductor materials and advanced packaging as demand for AI infrastructure accelerates. The business will be integrated into Qnity's Interconnect Solutions segment.

stories.title: Brookfield secures financing for PGP Glass acquisition
stories.summary: Brookfield is raising 750 million dollars in offshore financing to fund its 1.7 billion dollar acquisition of PGP Glass. The loan is expected to be priced at 270 basis points over the Secured Overnight Financing Rate with a five-year tenor. The deal remains in the final stages.

stories.title: International Paper approves DS Smith spin-off
stories.summary: International Paper has approved the spin-off of its EMEA packaging business, DS Smith, with a listing set for December 7. International Paper will retain a 19.9 percent stake in the new entity. The company will delist its own shares from the London Stock Exchange on December 22.

research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: PyCC is a Python-based quantum chemistry package that emphasizes coupled cluster and related methods. Developed over the last five years, PyCC's purpose is to provide a clear reference implementation that will serve as a validation suite. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
